data.title: Coinbase seeks approval for 24/5 leveraged contracts on Apple, Tesla, Nvidia, allowing US traders to trade without owning the stocks.
data.description: The application has been submitted for CFTC consideration, requesting approval for trading contracts that would allow American traders to have 24/5 access to leveraged positions on specific stocks without requiring actual ownership.

data.title: Trump promotes plan to lower Medicaid drug costs by aligning prices with other wealthy nations; all states have opted in.
data.description: In preparation for the upcoming midterm elections, the president announced that every state has chosen to participate in a program aiming to synchronize Medicaid's medication costs with those of affluent nations.

data.title: First Atlantic Nickel & Cobalt Raises 6.15 Million Dollars in No-Warrant, Non-Brokered Private Placement to Accelerate Mining Exploration and Development at Pipestone XL Nickel-Cobalt Alloy (Awaruite) Project in Newfoundland
data.description: First Atlantic Nickel & Cobalt has successfully secured a flow-through financing of $6.16 million to support the drilling and exploration activities at its Pipestone XL project. This funding will be utilized to advance the project and further enhance its mineral reserves.
